newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: At least 15 reported killed in Colombia road crash.
newsitem.headline: At least 15 reported killed in Colombia road crash.

text.p: At least 15 people were killed on Monday when a small passenger bus ploughed into a dump truck on a rural highway in Colombia's northern province of Sucre, the RCN radio network said.
It said 11 of the victims had been identified by late Monday evening and many were young students returning home from a regional school.
Highway police could not be reached for immediate comment, and RCN said the cause of the crash had not been determined.
